verdict.rationale: There is no documented bulk data-export feature. Exit is only indirectly supported: ACP is an Apache 2.0 open protocol that businesses can implement with 'any AI agent or payment processor', and a custom integration path supports third-party processors. Orders can be retrieved programmatically via the List CheckoutSessions endpoint, and either party can terminate an OCA at any time. The CSV catalog feed is documented only as an import path, not an export. Missing for 10: a documented full-account data export, open-format export of orders, transactions and catalog, migration or offboarding guidance, and independent corroboration.
